title: Motion Machine brand half (SPEC §3): the look

fictional.description: true for every shipped preset (AXIOM 3); false for a captured or hand-written real brand

source.description: where a captured brand came from; never a URL that the piece would load

surfaceInk.description: text on a surface (cards, panels, tiles, caption bars, device screens); ink when absent

composition.description: the grid and type hierarchy are part of the brand. Layouts take their default alignment and headline size from these; a beat's align param still overrides

align.description: default alignment of every layout (the kit exposes it as --mm-align: start or center)

headlineScale.description: multiplier on every layout headline (--mm-headline-scale); 1 is the reference hierarchy

density.description: spacing between a layout's blocks and its side indent (--mm-density: airy 1, compact 0.6)

accentText.description: false for a brand that never colours text: every pattern that would tint text with the accent uses ink (--mm-accent-text); accent fills are unchanged. Default true

devices.description: how device frames (phone, laptop, browser) are finished; optional, ink by default

finish.description: every finish is a palette role: ink, canvas (the surface), graphite (the darkest role), silver (the lightest)

ground.description: what sits behind every scene; optional, a flat canvas by default. Blobs are blurred shapes in the brand's own colours (added to the palette G-BRAND checks), placed and sized by shares of the frame; the mark is a picture centred and scaled past the frame, faint

x.description: left edge, share of the frame width

y.description: top edge, share of the frame height

w.description: width, share of the frame width

h.description: height, share of the frame height

blur.description: blur radius, share of the frame width

src.description: relative path from the piece page; never a URL (SPEC §2.6)

width.description: width, share of the frame width; above 1 the mark is clipped by the frame

finish.description: the surface look, each strength 0 to 1 and optional. Overlays above the scene; whatever can lie over text stays at or under 0.08 opacity

grain.description: film grain in ink, seeded from t at 12 Hz; like halftone it darkens the background a little, which W-CONTRAST measures

halftone.description: a fine dot screen in ink

vignette.description: the corners darken toward ink; inside the safe area it stays at or under 0.08

edgeFringe.description: a soft accent glow along the frame's edge, outside the safe area

paperEdge.description: a rough surface-coloured border inside the frame's edge, within the safe margin; it is a frame border, so W-BAN warns unless the brand lists `frame-borders` in `allow`

misregister.description: a print plate off register: the scene's shapes printed again in accent under themselves, offset down and to one side (at 1, 0.4 % of the frame width, the side seeded per scene); every emphasis kicks the plate and it settles before the rest. Stepped every 2/30 s; never over text

paper.description: a paper fibre in ink, static (it belongs to the stock, not the film), at no more than 0.08 opacity

mascot.description: the brand's character, drawn and acted by runtime/kit/rig.js. Every length is in the character's own unit (u), in SVG axes (y grows downward); the rig scales u to the slot. Parts are filled from palette roles only, so G-BRAND holds by construction

box.description: width and height of the whole character, legs included, in u

ground.description: the point between the feet, in the views' coordinates: squash, lean and hops pivot here and the shadow sits under it

views.description: drawn key views, each facing right (facing: left mirrors them). A missing 3/4 or side view is made from the front by moving the face toward the heading and narrowing it; a missing back is the front with no face

parts.description: the colour of each named part: a role, or a blend of two roles. Defaults: body accent; shade the body's role with 28 % of the darkest role; light the body's role with 35 % of the lightest role; outline, eyes and mouth ink (on a screen face's plate: the lightest role); glint surface; blush the body's role with 45 % of the lightest role; limbs the body's colour; shadow the darkest role; plate the darkest role. Any other name is an extra part (ears, a tail, an antenna, a hat, wings, a held prop): path data with an anchor, a layer, a swing and a colour

float.description: how far the character hovers above its ground point at rest, in u: a floating character (no legs) is drawn standing on the ground in its views and lifted by this much, bobbing gently; its shadow stays on the ground. Default 0

cast.description: further characters of the brand, by name, each a whole character with the same keys as the mascot (no cast of its own); a beat names one with the character patterns' `who` param

outline.description: outline weight factor; 0 draws no outline. Default 1

moods.description: the moods the brand lets its character show; a mood outside the list is drawn as the first one. Default: all eight

faces.description: the eye shapes and mouths the brand allows; a mood whose shape is not allowed wears the first allowed one. Default: all

ask.description: fields a capture could not measure (fonts from stills, for example), to be confirmed by hand; W-ASK warns while any remain

allow.description: bans this brand lifts, by name

oneOf.description: an sRGB blend of two roles: `share` of `mix` into `role`

path.description: SVG path data in u, nothing else: every number under 1000 and without an exponent. The rig also refuses a view whose drawing reaches more than 20 % of the box past the box about the ground point (the front then takes the rig's default figure, another view is made from the front), and clips what it draws to its slot

body.description: the silhouette, filled in the body colour and outlined last

strip.description: a side face drawn in the shade colour over the body (a block seen at 3/4)

seam.description: a line in the outline colour (the edge between front and side)

face.description: the face frame; null for a view with no face (the back)

fw.description: foreshortening of the face across: 1 front, about 0.75 at 3/4, 0.55 side. Default 1

mouth.description: the mouth's distance below the eye line. Default 1.3 eye heights

sides.description: both eyes, or only the near one (a side view). Default both

plate.description: a screen face: a rounded plate behind the eyes and the mouth, filled in the plate colour; the eyes and the mouth then default to the lightest role

r.description: corner radius. Default a fifth of the smaller side

y.description: the plate centre's distance below the eye line. Default half the mouth's

x.description: the anchor: an arm's shoulder, a leg's hip

length.description: an arm's length; a leg always reaches the ground

side.description: which way an arm points and which pose angle drives it; legs on the same side step together. Default by the sign of x

layer.description: drawn behind the body or in front of it. Default back

far.description: a far limb is drawn in the shade colour

extraPart.description: an extra part of the character, in the views' coordinates (u): drawn in every view (narrowed with a view made from the front) unless `views` names some

d.description: its shape, filled in its colour and outlined (or stroked, with `stroke`)

anchor.description: where it joins the body: it swings about this point

tip.description: the point whose lag sets the swing; parts that share an anchor and a tip turn as one. Default the centre of its drawing

layer.description: drawn behind the body or in front of it (under the face). Default front

swing.description: follow-through: how much it lags and swings about its anchor as the body hops, lands and takes. 0 holds it rigid. Default 0.5

stroke.description: draw it as a line of this width (an antenna's stalk, whiskers) instead of a filled shape

views.description: the views that show it. Default all

src.description: relative path inside the repo or the piece, or from a style file to a font in a brand folder (a folder name may hold spaces); never a URL (SPEC §2.6)
